finish_summary:
1) bulk_discount_percent: implementation returns 5% for quantity exactly 50 (spec expects 10%).
2) parse_coupon: implementation is case-sensitive; spec requires case-insensitive matching.
3) Cart.total: shipping fee computed on original subtotal, not on subtotal after coupon as per spec. This causes incorrect totals when a coupon reduces the amount below the free‑shipping threshold.
4) Cart.remove_item: when quantity removal results in negative remaining quantity, the implementation deletes the line instead of raising an error; spec indicates it should raise KeyError if item not present but does not explicitly forbid this behavior.

The test suite covers these discrepancies and confirms that the module diverges from its specification in the above areas.
